releaseNotes: 5 Authentic Real-World Speedometer Gauge Styles: 1) Cyan Semi-Circle Dial: 180° cyan arc gauge with radial ticks (0-180), bold red mechanical needle with solid circular red hub, and cyan odometer pill (000002). 2) Color TFT Superbike: Universal color TFT motorcycle cockpit with top telltale strip, arching segmented LED tachometer (0-12k RPM), flanking curved vertical fuel/temp arcs, and prominent N GEAR indicator. 3) Daytona Compact Dash: Daytona-style compact racing motorcycle meter with top horizontal RPM dot-matrix ladder (1-13k), large italic speed, boxed gear [N], and battery voltage. 4) Dual Angular GT: European supercar virtual cockpit with dual opposing angular gauge brackets and warm golden-amber glowing needle beams. 5) Shelby GT Track Cluster: Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 12-inch digital track cluster with dual high-rev dials, massive center digital speed, and embossed SHELBY GT500 script badge.
